sources.title: GitHub - aimerib/spoomplesmaxx
sources.snippet: These datasets are designed to train a Roleplay (RP), Creative Writing, and "Smart" Assistant model Spoomplesmaxx. The goal of combining these specific sets is to create a model that is narratively creative and capable of embodying characters, but also logically sound and capable of following complex instructions.

sources.title: aimeri/spoomplesmaxx-flash-35B-A3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SpoomplesMaxx is a generalist model with primary strengths in creative writing and roleplay, plus light competence at instruction following, reasoning, and — new in Flash — tool calling. Flash is the speed build: a 35B mixture-of-experts with only 3B active parameters per token, on a hybrid linear-attention backbone where just 10 of 40 layers keep a KV cache. sources.snippet: SpoomplesMaxx is a generalist model with primary strengths in creative writing and roleplay, plus light competence at instruction following and reasoning. The Mini brings the v2.1 data and training recipe to a 14B you can run on a single 24GB card.
